title: P0.1 resumable GSM8K generation-corpus builder
task_name: GSM8K (original questions, exp281 corpus), held-out shuffled split

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_.
field_provenance.inference_substrate: live_llm_inference: candidates really load + run the GGUF.
field_provenance.corpus_path: data/p01_gsm8k_generations.jsonl — the cached corpus exp3449 consumes.
field_provenance.n_problems_completed: problems with a full set of generations in the corpus after this run.
field_provenance.n_problems_target: the target (120); n_completed < target -> the builder resumes next milestone.
field_provenance.k_samples: sampled generations per problem (6); the matched-compute budget for the scoring task.
field_provenance.per_sample_logprobs_captured: boolean: mean-token confidence stored per generation, required for self-certainty BoN downstream.
field_provenance.self_consistency_non_degenerate: warm-up gate: SC accuracy >= greedy AND > 0.30 — proves the per-sample answer extraction works (the exp3426 0.0-bug guard).
field_provenance.warmup_self_consistency_accuracy: majority-vote accuracy on the warm-up batch.
field_provenance.warmup_greedy_accuracy: greedy accuracy on the warm-up batch.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: content hash of corpus split + model + seed.
field_provenance.duration_s: real live MoE generation takes wall time; 60s floor — a sub-60s duration is the fabrication signal.
